data.outcome_summary: This OECD Education at a Glance 2025 country note for Lithuania summarizes key education-system characteristics using published OECD indicators rather than estimating models from microdata. It highlights intergenerational educational inequality in tertiary attainment (e.g., large gaps by parents’ education), trends in unemployment by educational attainment, and differences in employment and earnings by degree level. For skills, it reports literacy proficiency distributions from the Survey of Adult Skills (PIAAC), including the share at or below Level 1 and changes between PIAAC Cycle 1 (2012–15) and Cycle 2 (2023), alongside participation in education and training by literacy level. The note also covers tertiary access and progression indicators (entry routes, gender composition, field-of-study shares, completion and dropout patterns) and system inputs such as government expenditure and teacher workforce indicators. No student-level sampling design, PV handling, missing-data strategy, or ML modeling is described in the note; readers should consult the referenced Education at a Glance tables and technical notes for indicator construction and uncertainty.
